framework_principle.name: STAY_FAIL_CLOSED_KEEP_FUTURE_OPEN
framework_principle.statement: Stay fail closed and keep future open!
framework_principle.scope: QIK-VRT Tested Event Model Driven Development
framework_principle.fail_closed: Missing, stale, contradictory, unbound, or insufficient evidence never becomes authority, release, completion, or effect.
framework_principle.future_open: A fail-closed state preserves every admissible future continuation; it must not erase evidence, obligations, provenance, alternatives, or the possibility of a later freshly evidenced transition.
framework_principle.eye_in_the_storm: Every effect-producing path retains an independent reobservation boundary: act without self-certifying the effect; reobserve from the declared evidence boundary before claiming completion.
framework_principle.return_path_closure: The reverse path returns the original bound request plus every material descendant, produced artifact, observed effect, failure, repair, successor, and still-open obligation. Returned predecessor evidence remains provenance and is never transferred as proof for a mutated subject.
framework_principle.terminal_rule: D.o.D. and EFFECT_ACK_DONE are admissible only after exact post-effect reobservation of every predicate in the declared completion scope.

boundary_contract.composition_rule: 3 = 1 + 2; weight 4 opens the next orthogonal composition dimension without redefining D0[1:0]

register_binding.D0: low two bits are the invariant QIK-VRT/TEMDD boundary decision

wire_protocol.chunking: message_id plus zero-based chunk_index/chunk_count; each frame is independently bounded and verified
wire_protocol.receipt_binding: reverse RECEIPT repeats session_id, nonce, message_id, chunk_index and chunk_count and carries SHA-256(request_frame) as payload
wire_protocol.release_rule: a transport roundtrip never implies EFFECT_ACK_DONE; the bounded reference witness emits D4=EFFECT_ACK_DONE only after decode, local state application, contract verification and post-apply byte reobservation

overlay_model.decision_link: ordinary release is allowed only from stable EFFECT_ACK_DONE

effect_boundary.note: No protocol label establishes physical correspondence, quantum identity, or empirical model closure.

logic_0124_note: 0 is the unset state; 1,2,4 are orthogonal binary weights. D0[1:0] carries 0..3, with 3 composed as 1+2. Bit weight 4 extends composition context and must not redefine the four D0 boundary meanings.
